title: Development and validation of a brief screener for posttraumatic stress disorder risk in emergency medical settings.
summary: Machine-learning recursive feature elimination selected a five-item ISRC screener that discriminated later non-remitting PTSD-symptom versus resilient trajectories in a prospective development sample (N=253; AUC 0.80) and independent external sample (N=93; AUC 0.84). It predicts symptom trajectories and is not a PTSD diagnosis or evidence of improved clinical outcomes.
ai_technology: Recursive feature elimination using random forests selected five of 27 ISRC items; XGBoost then predicted latent non-remitting versus resilient PTSD-symptom trajectories.
